# Source: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max: # Adapted for wisp-design: schema condensed to 6 columns; web stacks only.
# Sample shipped in Phase 4 — full corpus lands in Phase 7. See skills/data/corpus/README.md.

column3: prompt
column4: css_template
column5: checklist

column3: Primary action button — sans, generous padding, single accent
column4: padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--mm-accent); color: oklch(98% 0 0); border-radius: var(--mm-radius); font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 200ms var(--mm-ease);
column5: ☐ AA contrast verified ☐ focus-visible ring ☐ hover-state shifts background only ☐ 44x44 touch min

column3: Secondary action — outlined, restrained
column4: padding: 12px 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--mm-fg); border: 1px solid var(--mm-border); border-radius: var(--mm-radius); font-weight: 500;
column5: ☐ AA contrast on border ☐ hover shifts border-color ☐ disabled state opacity 0.5

column3: Tertiary action — no chrome, hover-only emphasis
column4: padding: 12px 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--mm-fg-muted); border-radius: var(--mm-radius); font-weight: 500; transition: color 150ms;
column5: ☐ hover shifts color to fg ☐ visible focus ring ☐ adequate touch target

column3: Feature card — single-column, generous padding, subtle border
column4: padding: var(--mm-pad); background: var(--mm-bg-elev); border: 1px solid var(--mm-border); border-radius: var(--mm-radius);
column5: ☐ no nested cards ☐ headline weight 600 ☐ body line-height 1.55 ☐ dark-mode token paired

column3: Product card — image-top, no shadow, hover-shifts-border
column4: display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--mm-border); border-radius: var(--mm-radius); transition: border-color 200ms;
column5: ☐ image aspect-ratio locked ☐ price as tabular-nums ☐ hover affordance visible

column3: Marketing hero — centered, single value prop, single CTA
column4: max-width: 72ch; margin-inline: auto; padding-block: 96px; text-align: center;
column5: ☐ headline max 12 words ☐ subhead max 22 words ☐ single primary CTA ☐ no hero-metric template

column3: Product hero — side-by-side text+image, asymmetric grid
column4: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center; padding-block: 80px;
column5: ☐ mobile collapses to stacked ☐ image lazy-load ☐ headline weight 600

column3: Top nav — sticky, transparent-on-scroll-top, blurred-on-scroll
column4: position: sticky; top: 0; padding: 16px 32px; background: var(--mm-bg); border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: border-color 200ms, backdrop-filter 200ms;
column5: ☐ keyboard-nav works ☐ skip-link present ☐ aria-current on active item

column3: Sidebar nav — fixed-width, scroll-internal, collapsible
column4: width: 240px; height: 100dvh; padding: 16px; border-right: 1px solid var(--mm-border); overflow-y: auto;
column5: ☐ active item aria-current ☐ collapse mobile to drawer ☐ touch target ≥44px

column3: Text input — labeled-above, subtle border, focus-ring
column4: padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--mm-bg); border: 1px solid var(--mm-border); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 16px;
column5: ☐ font-size 16px+ iOS ☐ autocomplete attr ☐ visible label ☐ AA contrast

column3: Form label — above input, mid-weight
column4: display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--mm-fg);
column5: ☐ for attribute matches input id ☐ required indicator visible

column3: Inline form error — below input, semantic color
column4: margin-top: 6px; font-size: 13px; color: oklch(55% 0.20 25);
column5: ☐ aria-describedby links to error ☐ icon + text (not color alone)

column3: Data table — alternating-row off, tabular-nums, subtle dividers
column4: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px;
column5: ☐ tabular-nums on numeric cols ☐ sticky header on scroll ☐ row hover affordance

column3: Vertical list — sibling-gap, no chrome
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;
column5: ☐ list semantic ul/li ☐ items have unique aria-label

column3: Modal dialog — overlay + centered card, focus-trap
column4: position: fixed; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; background: oklch(10% 0 0 / 0.5);
column5: ☐ focus-trap engaged ☐ ESC closes ☐ ARIA dialog role ☐ inert background

column3: Toast notification — bottom-right, slide-in, auto-dismiss
column4: position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--mm-bg-elev); border: 1px solid var(--mm-border); border-radius: var(--mm-radius); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -4px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.12);
column5: ☐ aria-live polite ☐ dismissible ☐ stacks vertically

column3: Empty state — centered, specific microcopy, single CTA
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 64px 24px; text-align: center;
column5: ☐ specific copy (no 'Welcome to') ☐ next-action CTA ☐ small visual marker if needed

column3: Loading spinner — minimal, prefers-reduced-motion friendly
column4: width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 2px solid var(--mm-border); border-top-color: var(--mm-accent); border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 800ms linear infinite;
column5: ☐ prefers-reduced-motion freezes ☐ aria-label set ☐ adequate size

column3: Skeleton loader — shimmer subtle, content-shape match
column4: background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--mm-bg-elev) 0%, var(--mm-border) 50%, var(--mm-bg-elev) 100%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: shimmer 1.5s linear infinite;
column5: ☐ matches final layout shape ☐ animation respects reduced-motion ☐ aria-busy=true

column3: Status badge — pill, semantic color, mid-weight
column4: display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; background: var(--mm-success-soft); color: var(--mm-success);
column5: ☐ semantic color + icon + text ☐ accessible name ☐ adequate contrast

column3: Filter tag — pill, removable, mid-weight
column4: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--mm-bg-elev); color: var(--mm-fg-muted); font-size: 13px;
column5: ☐ remove button is keyboard-reachable ☐ aria-label includes action

column3: Breadcrumb — separator dot, current bold
column4: display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--mm-fg-muted);
column5: ☐ aria-label='Breadcrumb' ☐ aria-current='page' on last

column3: Pagination — number-buttons, no arrows-only
column4: display: flex; gap: 4px;
column5: ☐ aria-current='page' on current ☐ disabled state opacity 0.5 ☐ jump-to-first/last present

column3: Section divider — thin, subtle
column4: height: 1px; background: var(--mm-border); margin-block: 48px;
column5: ☐ semantic <hr> when between sections ☐ aria-hidden for decorative

column3: Marketing footer — multi-column, generous padding, muted
column4: padding-block: 64px; background: var(--mm-bg-elev); border-top: 1px solid var(--mm-border);
column5: ☐ semantic <footer> ☐ multi-column responsive ☐ legal links present

column3: Testimonial — blockquote semantic, specific quote
column4: padding: 24px; border-left: 2px solid var(--mm-accent); background: transparent;
column5: ☐ <blockquote>+<cite> semantic ☐ no stock avatar ☐ specific quote (not generic)

column3: Pricing card — mid-tier highlight, single emphasis method
column4: padding: 32px; background: var(--mm-bg-elev); border: 2px solid var(--mm-accent); border-radius: var(--mm-radius); position: relative;
column5: ☐ ONE emphasis method only (border OR shadow OR scale) ☐ feature list semantic

column3: Hero CTA — primary + supporting microcopy below
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
column5: ☐ single primary CTA ☐ no decorative em-dashes ☐ specific verb (not 'Submit')

column3: Feature grid — 3-column, equal-height, breathing room
column4: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 32px;
column5: ☐ mobile collapses to 1-col ☐ items not visually equal-weight (vary copy length)

column3: Feature icon — 24px lucide, accent-on-hover
column4: width: 24px; height: 24px; stroke: var(--mm-fg-muted); transition: stroke 200ms;
column5: ☐ stroke not fill ☐ aria-hidden if decorative ☐ adequate contrast
